summary: Iteration 66 — verified the Catholic World Map expansion to 270 sites / 84 countries, the new 'Saint of the place near you' card with mini-pilgrimage planner, and end-to-end appearance on the Calendar. Backend pytest 8/8 PASS (/api/sites total=270 with 84 unique countries and 270 unique site_ids; idempotent across repeat GET; /api/sites/nearby with no params returns up to 8 items (daily-rotating fallback); /api/sites/nearby?lat=41.9&lng=12.45 returns items sorted ascending by distance_km with nearest=St. Peter's Basilica; Accept-Language: es localizes nearby names/history vs EN; POST /api/schedule with kind='pilgrimage' creates and the kind persists; GET /api/schedule lists it; DELETE /api/schedule/{id} removes it). Frontend (390x844, philipwils13@gmail.com, vocation=marriage/living): /community/map renders testID 'saint-near-you' with site name (Valencia Cathedral — daily-rotating pick, correct fallback since web preview has no geolocation), Plan opens 'pilgrimage-picker' which contains all five required date options (today/tomorrow/this-saturday/this-sunday/next-saturday); selecting 'pilgrimage-date-this-saturday' closes the picker and shows 'map-toast' = 'Added to your calendar for This Saturday.' Calendar (/calendar) shows the corresponding schedule-dot on Sat 2026-06-27 and tapping the cell surfaces 'Pilgrimage: Valencia Cathedral' in the day detail panel — full end-to-end map→schedule→calendar loop confirmed. Cleanup: all 3 test pilgrimage items deleted from DB. ONE BLOCKING UI GAP: the spec calls for opening detail sheets via 'map-toggle-list then a row', but the map screen has setShowList state without any visible toggle button (testID 'map-toggle-list' does not exist anywhere in /app/frontend/app/community/map.tsx). As a result the 'map-plan-pilgrimage' button inside the site detail sheet could not be exercised through the intended UI path. Minor: console warns 'Encountered two children with the same key' on the map screen (suggests a duplicate React key in the marker or list render — should be diagnosed). Deprecated/carry-over warnings: RNW shadow* and expo-notifications web listener (cosmetic).

ui_bugs.issue: showList state is defined and a fully styled list renderer exists (lines 226-245), but no button calls setShowList(true). The spec's testID 'map-toggle-list' is absent from the file, so users cannot reach the list view or the in-sheet 'Plan a mini pilgrimage' button (testID map-plan-pilgrimage) through the UI. Reference: /app/frontend/app/community/map.tsx:78,226

Console: 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires every time the map screen renders. Likely a duplicated key in markers/list rendering (markers use site_id which is unique, but the list rows in 226-245 also use site_id). Suggest auditing for any earlier render path that maps over sites with a non-unique key. Reference: /app/frontend/app/community/map.tsx

action_items: Add a list/map toggle in community/map.tsx header with testID='map-toggle-list' that calls setShowList(prev => !prev). Without it the 'Plan a mini pilgrimage' button inside the site detail sheet is unreachable from the UI, and the spec's detail-sheet flow cannot be tested.
Investigate the 'Encountered two children with the same key' console error on /community/map (likely a duplicate key in a map() — check both the markers array and any DetailSection items).
critical_code_review_comments: catholic_sites.py: SEED_SITES has 270 entries spanning 84 countries; all site_ids unique; _seed_if_missing is idempotent (insert only when slug absent) — verified by back-to-back GET /api/sites.

catholic_sites.py nearby_sites: when lat/lng are provided, uses haversine and sorts ascending — verified nearest to Rome (41.9, 12.45) is St. Peter's Basilica. When no params, applies a daily ordinal rotation through a name-sorted list and truncates to 8 — matches spec.

schedule.py: KINDS includes 'pilgrimage' (line 27) and DEFAULTS maps it to footsteps-outline/#7A5CB0 — kind persists on create and DELETE removes correctly. Calendar already renders schedule-dot-{date} for any kind, including pilgrimage.

frontend/app/community/map.tsx: 'saint-near-you' + 'saint-near-plan' + 'pilgrimage-picker' + 'pilgrimage-date-*' + 'map-toast' all wired and working. createScheduleItem({kind:'pilgrimage', recurrence:'once', date, ref_slug, …}) succeeds. HOWEVER showList has no toggle button — see action items.
frontend/app/(tabs)/calendar.tsx: schedule-dot-{date} renders for pilgrimage items; day-tap reveals 'Pilgrimage: Valencia Cathedral' in the detail panel.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds the missing list/map toggle (testID 'map-toggle-list'), re-run the detail-sheet flow: tap map-toggle-list → tap any map-list-{slug} → in the detail sheet tap map-plan-pilgrimage → pick a date → confirm map-toast and Calendar dot. Backend is solid; only the list-toggle UI is missing. The duplicate-key console error is cosmetic but worth fixing for cleanliness.
rca_of_issue: Map screen 'list view' code path exists (lines 226-245 of /app/frontend/app/community/map.tsx) and setShowList is declared at line 78, but the header (lines 176-183) never renders a button that calls setShowList(true). Therefore the 'showList ? <ScrollView…> : <MapView…>' branch is permanently false from the user's perspective, and the in-sheet 'Plan a mini pilgrimage' button (map-plan-pilgrimage) — though correctly wired to open the picker — cannot be reached. Fix: add a Pressable next to the back button (e.g., header right) with testID='map-toggle-list' and an onPress that toggles showList; alternatively, also expose a Pressable that opens the detail sheet for the daily-pick site (planFor would still flow through the existing picker).
